Primstone Workforce Logistics LLC is a Georgia company based minutes from Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport. We provide temporary staffing, workforce management, recruitment support, customer service, administrative services and managed operational solutions.

Our clients are rental-car companies, airport and aviation businesses, transportation and logistics providers, hospitality, retail, facilities and other commercial operations — businesses where an uncovered shift means vehicles don't move and customers wait.

## What We Do

- **Workforce deployment and supervision** — scheduling, on-site supervisors and operational reporting.
- **Fleet operations** — vehicle shuttling and relocation, staging, cleaning, inspection and preparation, and lot operations.
- **Customer and business support** — customer service, call center support, dispatch and logistics coordination, and administrative services.
- **Continuous improvement** — quality control, process improvement and workforce solutions customized to each client.

## Our Commitment

- **Our own employees.** Every worker is our own W-2 employee — insured, trained and accountable to us.
- **Supervision included.** A dedicated supervisor leads every site.
- **Transparency.** Attendance and hours are tracked in real time and shared with you.
- **Local first.** We recruit, train and operate in metro Atlanta."}}]}, {"node": "flabout_009", "element": "col", "data": {"label": "StoryImg", "animation": "fade-left"}, "elements": [{"node":
